item.text: {"claim_id":"C020","obligation_id":"C020-B-1","contract":"GOVERNANCE_STRUCTURE","subject":"Alignment should stop if alternative alignments remain equally plausible.","verdict":"SATISFIED","unresolved_conditions":[],"rationale":"The rule prospectively links a recognizable epistemic trigger—alternative alignments remaining tied after comparison—to a definite response: stop alignment.
